newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith Retail managing director quits.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith Retail managing director quits.

text.p: British retailer WH Smith Group Plc said on Friday that Peter Bamford, managing director of WH Smith Retail, would leave the company with immediate effect.
Bamford, a main board director at WH Smith Group, was leaving by mutual consent, the company said in a statement.
WH Smith said group chief executive Bill Cockburn would become chairman of the WH Smith Retail board and a new managing director would be appointed in the near future.

The company said responsibility for the 100 travel-retail shops based at Britain's airports and railway stations would be transferred from WH Smith Retail into a separate division with its own managing director.
Also, the logistics and distribution arm of WH Smith Retail would be set up as a separate entity reporting to Richard Handover, managing director of WH Smith News.
